verification.title: Prediction of neural activity in connectome-constrained recurrent networks
verification.species: Drosophila melanogaster and Danio rerio (empirical connectomes)
verification.supported_claim: A connectome often does not substantially constrain recurrent dynamics, but recordings from a small subset of neurons can remove the degeneracy and reproduce teacher dynamics.
verification.forbidden_inference: Does not identify biological dynamics from connectivity alone; teacher network is simulated; no ECAP/SCS/nociception transfer.
verification.verification: HTTP 200 fetched original; Crossref identity confirmed; card verified_primary/checked

sources.title: Prediction of neural activity in connectome-constrained recurrent networks
sources.limitations: Theory and simulation of neural-activity identifiability with empirical connectome topologies. The teacher network is simulated ground truth; observing a subset of teacher neurons is not a biological recording comparator for the inferred dynamics. No nociception, ECAP or SCS transfer is tested.
